title: Quenching the Quantum Tunneling of Magnetization in Heterometallic Octanuclear {TMIII4DyIII4} (TM=Co and Cr) Single-Molecule Magnets by Modification of the Bridging Ligands and Enhancing the Magnetic Exchange Coupling

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetracobalt(III) tetradysprosium(III) tetra(μ-hydroxido) tetra(μ3-methoxido) tetrakis(pivalato) tetrakis(triethanolaminato) tetraaqua tetrahydrate

material_class.structural_family: heterometallic octanuclear {Co4Dy4} cluster with a square {Dy4} core

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, Co(BF4)2·6H2O (0.34 g, 1 mmol) and Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.44 g, 1 mmol) were dissolved in MeCN (20 mL), followed by addition of triethanolamine (0.14 mL, 1 mmol), pivalic acid (0.10 g, 1.0 mmol) and triethylamine (0.55 mL, 4.0 mmol). The resulting dark green solution was stirred for 4 h. The solvent was removed to give a green oil, which was redissolved in MeOH and layered with Et2O. Green crystals of 1 appeared within 4–5 d.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution reaction followed by solvent removal, redissolution and ether layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvent removed to a green oil; redissolved in MeOH and layered with diethyl ether to give green crystals

properties.summary: DC χMT at 1 T agrees with four non-interacting DyIII ions and diamagnetic low-spin CoIII. χMT = 56.68 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, falling to 18.72 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, consistent with crystal-field depopulation and weak antiferromagnetic Dy···Dy exchange (JDy–Dy ≈ −1.6 cm−1 from modelling). AC data in zero DC field show only frequency-dependent χM″ tails below 3 K with no maxima above 2 K; a 3000 Oe DC field shifts signals but QTM remains. No Ueff was extracted; 1 is not an SMM above 2 K.

measurements.value: frequency-dependent tails below 3 K; no χM″ maxima above 2 K

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, Co(NO3)2·6H2O (0.29 g, 1 mmol) and Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.44 g, 1 mmol) were dissolved in MeCN (20 mL), followed by addition of N-methyldiethanolamine (0.12 mL, 1 mmol), ortho-toluic acid (0.13 g, 1 mmol), sodium fluoride (0.08 g, 2 mmol) and triethylamine (0.55 mL, 4.0 mmol). The dark green solution was stirred for 4 h. The solvent was removed to a green oil, which was redissolved in MeOH/EtOH (1:1) and layered with Et2O. Green crystals of 2 appeared within 8–10 d.

properties.summary: SMM. Room-temperature χMT = 56.27 cm3 K mol−1 (1 T), falling to 19.61 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Zero-field AC susceptibility shows frequency-dependent χM″ below 12 K with a low-T QTM upturn; 5000 Oe DC field reveals multiple relaxation processes. Arrhenius fit of the slowest process (8–10.5 K, HDC = 0) gives Ueff = 39 ± 1 cm−1 and τ0 = 1.0 × 10−6 s. Fluoride-for-hydroxide substitution lengthens relaxation relative to 1 but QTM remains at low T.
